queries_run: AMD largest customer second-source OR in-house 2026
Microsoft Meta custom AI chip second source agreement AMD 2026
AMD single-source risk customer diversify supplier 10-K 2026
hyperscaler in-house chip insourcing AMD Instinct GPU replace 2026

findings.claim: Meta（AMD 6GW Instinct GPU 合約的客戶）在簽下輝達與 AMD 大單數週後，宣布擴大自研 AI 晶片 MTIA（in-house）部署
findings.source: CNBC, "Meta rolls out in-house AI chips weeks after massive Nvidia, AMD deals", https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/11/meta-ai-mtia-chip-data-center.html

findings.claim: Broadcom 被證實是 Google TPU、Meta MTIA、Microsoft Maia，以及 2026 年初起 OpenAI／Anthropic Titan 自研 AI 晶片專案的設計夥伴——顯示 AMD 多個大型 AI 客戶同時在推進自製晶片路線
findings.source: Tom's Hardware, "The custom AI ASIC state of play (May 2026)", https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/semiconductors/custom-ai-asics-examined-from-broadcom-to-mtia

findings.claim: Microsoft 自研 AI 晶片 Maia 200 於 2026 年 1 月開始部署（台積電 3nm 製程），號稱比現有機隊每美元效能高 30%——微軟同時也是 AMD Instinct 的客戶之一
findings.source: Windows News, "AI Compute Crunch: How Meta and Microsoft's Chip Deals Shape the 2026 Race", https://windowsnews.ai/article/ai-compute-crunch-how-meta-and-microsofts-chip-deals-shape-the-2026-race.411832

customer_second_source.note: 查到的都是客戶端（Meta／Microsoft／Google 等）同時併行自研晶片的證據，不是「棄用 AMD 改用他家」的直接訊號；未查到 AMD 客戶名單中有客戶正式棄單或宣布改用競品 second-source 的具體聲明。
